reported_quantity: % of 30 obfuscated prompts using the fictionalization technique to Claude (Claude Sonnet 4.5) that produced health disinformation

reported_quantity: % of GPT 3.5 answers to 58 Dutch self-care questions rated 1 = inaccurate (completely incorrect and/or could lead to serious consequences)
